text: XEON's 11 nodes all "Up 10 days" — so XEON-Storj(14091)/storj-node91 has recovered. The monitor isn't on the tunnel boxes. Let me query the monitor directly via curl (IPv6, as before) to get authoritative node state and confirm what sits behind the over-cap boxes.

args: {"command":"\"=== monitor via curl [::1] ===\"; $r = & curl -s -m 30 \"http://[::1]:8765/api/scan\" 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $r) { $j = $r | ConvertFrom-Json; \"NODES=$($j.Count)\"; $off = $j | Where-Object { -not $_.online } | Select-Object host,install,port,nodeId,contactAddress; \"OFFLINE COUNT=$($off.Count)\"; $off | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output } else { \"CURL_FAIL exit=$LASTEXITCODE len=$($r.Length)\" }","description":"Query monitor API via curl for offline nodes","timeoutMs":45000}
